clue.text: Reckon the principal is only a front man

parts.note: to reckon is to figure, to work something out
the principal of a school is its head

explanation.surface: A suspicious remark that the boss is merely a public face for someone else.
explanation.definitionFit: A figurehead is a nominal leader with no real power, a mere public face for those who run things.

clue.text: Legendary footballers suffered extortion

parts.note: FA is the Football Association, the body governing English footballers
someone squeezed for money is said to be bled

explanation.surface: Famous footballers were blackmailed.
explanation.definitionFit: Something fabled is told of in stories and legends, hence famous or mythical.

clue.text: I got no order to investigate

indicators.note: putting the letters of the three words into a new order signals rearrangement

explanation.surface: Someone complains they were given no instruction to look into a matter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'order' looks like a command, but it asks for the letters of I GOT NO to be rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: To go into a matter is to examine or explore it in detail.

clue.text: Dextrous sidekick

parts.note: a trusted assistant described playfully as a handy helper who favours the dexter, the right side

explanation.surface: A nimble-fingered assistant.
explanation.walkthrough: Dexter is Latin for right, so 'dextrous' hints at the right hand, the side a chief aide stands on.
explanation.definitionFit: A chief assistant is traditionally the one on the right of the leader, the trusted helper.

clue.text: Chop up hard wood

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils
ash is a timber tree and its wood

explanation.surface: An instruction to split some tough timber.
explanation.definitionFit: To hash food is to cut it into small pieces.

clue.text: French friend with talent and charm

parts.note: ami is the French word for a friend
a talent is a natural ability

explanation.surface: A Frenchman praised for his gifts and his engaging manner.
explanation.definitionFit: Charm and amiability both describe a pleasing, friendly manner.

clue.text: Old biblical scholars taking chances

parts.note: a DD is a Doctor of Divinity, so DDS are several such scholars

explanation.surface: Ancient students of scripture being risk-takers.
explanation.walkthrough: The grid as filed prints ODOS, but the wordplay builds ODDS, the word meaning chances.
explanation.definitionFit: Odds are the likelihoods or probabilities of something happening.

clue.text: Late last month pressure was taken off

parts.note: December, abbreviated DEC, is the last month of the year
when pressure is relieved things are eased

explanation.surface: Someone died at the end of the month, once the strain had lifted.
explanation.definitionFit: The late someone means a person who has died.

clue.text: Army man used agents without hesitation

indicators.note: without in its old sense of outside: the scrambled letters go around the other piece
agents who are used are put to work in a different way, so the word is reworked

parts.note: ER is the sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: A soldier deployed his spies without pausing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'without' is used in its old sense of outside, not lacking: the reworked letters wrap around the hesitation sound rather than dropping it.
explanation.definitionFit: A sergeant is a non-commissioned officer in the army.

clue.text: Come sartorially prepared to prosecute

explanation.surface: Arrive dressed for court.
explanation.definitionFit: Literally, arriving with a set of clothes; in law, to bring a suit is to start proceedings against someone.

clue.text: One has to get the right tree

parts.note: an ace counts as one in cards and dice
R is the abbreviation for right

explanation.surface: Someone must find the correct tree.
explanation.definitionFit: Acer is the botanical genus of maples.

clue.text: Question in debate the purpose of discipline

explanation.surface: Asking in a debate what discipline is for.
explanation.definitionFit: A procedural query raised in a formal meeting; and point (aim) of order (discipline).

clue.text: English country property

parts.note: a state is a nation or country

explanation.surface: A large house and grounds in the English countryside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'country property' reads as one phrase, but 'country' gives STATE and only 'property' defines.
explanation.definitionFit: An estate is land and buildings owned by someone, or everything they possess.

clue.text: A brother takes entrance money to make cancellation

parts.note: brother gives BRO
the gate is the money taken from spectators at a match

explanation.surface: A sibling pockets ticket takings in order to cancel something.
explanation.walkthrough: GATE is the takings at a sports ground, from the gate spectators pay at.
explanation.definitionFit: To abrogate a law or agreement is to repeal or annul it.

clue.text: Hide lighter components from miserly men

parts.note: a hide is an animal's skin
a cigarette lighter sparks with a flint

explanation.surface: Concealing parts of a cigarette lighter from stingy fellows.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Hide' poses as a verb, but it is the noun, an animal's skin.
explanation.definitionFit: A skinflint is a mean person who hates spending money.

clue.text: Fly-by-night seaman learnt no manoeuvres

parts.note: a jack, or jack tar, is a sailor

indicators.note: manoeuvres move the letters of the two words about into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: An untrustworthy sailor failed to learn his drill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'manoeuvres' rearranges LEARNT NO to OLANTERN. 'Fly-by-night' means a shady person on the surface, but here it is a light that flits by night.
explanation.definitionFit: A will-o'-the-wisp, the wandering marsh light seen at night, is also called this.

clue.text: Weapon one male Italian concealed in small motor

indicators.note: being hidden within something means sitting inside it

parts.note: a motor is a car
I is the Roman numeral one
IT is a short form for Italian, as in gin and it

explanation.surface: A sword carried by an Italian man hidden in a little car.
explanation.walkthrough: 'concealed in' puts IMIT inside SCAR, between the C and the A.
explanation.definitionFit: A scimitar is a curved oriental sword.

clue.text: Leaving a child is improper conduct

parts.note: leaving is going away
a son is a male child

explanation.surface: Abandoning a child is bad behaviour.
explanation.definitionFit: Goings-on are happenings, especially of a suspicious or disreputable kind.

clue.text: Combined action gains service boss admission to ministry

parts.note: CO is a commanding officer in the armed services
ordination admits a person to the Christian ministry

explanation.surface: A military chief joins the clergy, and together they act.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ministry' looks like a government department, but it is the church's ministry.
explanation.definitionFit: Coordination is the organising of parts to work together.

clue.text: After class a pupil becomes stiff

indicators.note: the a and the pupil come after the class piece in the answer

parts.note: a form is a class in a British school
L stands for learner, a pupil driver

explanation.surface: A schoolchild becomes rigid once lessons are over.
explanation.walkthrough: FORM is a school class in Britain; L is the learner plate on a pupil driver's car.
explanation.definitionFit: Formal means stiffly correct and conventional in manner.

clue.text: In church a steward must be virtuous

indicators.note: the answer sits in the run of letters across these words

explanation.surface: A church official is expected to be morally upright.
explanation.definitionFit: Chaste means pure, abstaining from improper sexual conduct.

clue.text: Males agree in intellectual terms

parts.note: men are males
figures that tally agree with each other

explanation.surface: Men reaching an agreement on intellectual matters.
explanation.definitionFit: Mentally means with regard to the mind.

clue.text: Semitic idol doctor found by island lake

annotationWithheld.why: Semitic idol doctor found by island lake: MO (doctor) + LOCH (lake) gives MOLOCH, but 'island' supplies no letters and has no job; possibly an OCR misread that the scan cannot confirm
annotationWithheld.clue: Semitic idol doctor found by island lake

clue.text: Stop to get a house in Washington

indicators.note: the house piece goes in the Washington piece

parts.note: WA is the postal abbreviation for Washington state

explanation.surface: Being told to halt in order to get a home in the US capital.
explanation.definitionFit: Whoa is the command to a horse to halt.

clue.text: Examine a shell

explanation.surface: Inspect a seashell.
explanation.definitionFit: To test is to try out; in zoology a test is the hard covering of some invertebrates such as sea urchins.

clue.text: Gloomy folk deposit rubbish there

explanation.surface: Rubbish tips are depressing places.
explanation.definitionFit: Being down in spirits; and literally where people tip their waste, at the dumps.

clue.text: Most disagreeable row

explanation.surface: A very unpleasant quarrel.
explanation.definitionFit: Rank means foul or utterly offensive; a rank is also a line or row, as of soldiers.

clue.text: Shoe seller paid for repair

indicators.note: a repair puts things back together in a fresh way, so the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A shoe shop owner paid to have something mended.
explanation.definitionFit: An espadrille is a canvas shoe with a rope sole.
